title: How Johnny Klebitz lost his brotherhood in GTA 4
subject: johnny
description:
Would you have followed Billy Grey back to war? 👇

How Johnny Klebitz, vice president of The Lost MC, watched his club fall apart when Billy Grey came home. Spoilers for GTA IV: The Lost and Damned.

scenes.text: Johnny Klebitz ran a biker club while its president sat in rehab.
In 2008 he was vice president of The Lost in Alderney, at peace with the rival Angels of Death.
Then Billy Grey came home. In the first mission, Clean and Serene, Billy walked out of rehab and took the club back.
Billy's first order was to ride on the Angels and take back the bike they stole while he was gone.
Johnny had sworn his life to the patch on his back.
Now that patch belonged to a man he no longer trusted.
